title: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) — Mock 09
pattern: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 120 min · no −ve)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a gassy seam of the second or third degree, no person shall supervise or operate electrical machinery unless he:
options: Holds a gas-testing certificate and carries an approved flame safety lamp
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(2): in 2nd/3rd-degree gassy seams, operators of electrical machinery (other than telephones/signals/lamps) hold a gas-testing certificate and carry an approved flame safety lamp.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: As per DGMS Circular 2/2010, strata and dump slope monitoring is mandatory for dumps exceeding ______ in height.
questions.solution: DGMS Circular 2/2010: monitoring (including slope stability radar / real-time monitoring) is made mandatory for dumps exceeding 60 m height.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a pressurized water reactor (PWR), the moderator used is:
questions.solution: PWR uses light water as both moderator and coolant. Heavy water is used in CANDU type reactors.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a moderator in a nuclear reactor is to:
questions.solution: Moderator slows fast neutrons (2 MeV) to thermal energies (0.025 eV) to sustain chain reaction.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a solar PV cell, the maximum efficiency is achieved when:
questions.solution: PV cell efficiency decreases with temperature. Lower temperature increases Voc and efficiency.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The fill factor of a solar cell is defined as:
questions.solution: Fill factor = P_max/(V_oc × I_sc), indicating how 'square' the IV curve is.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Wind turbine generators typically use which type of generator for fixed-speed operation?
questions.solution: Fixed-speed wind turbines use squirrel cage induction generators connected directly to the grid.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: DGMS (Tech.) (S&T) Circular No. 02 of 2010 deals with:
options: Design, control and monitoring of pit and dump slopes in opencast mines
questions.solution: DGMS (Tech.) (S&T) Circular No. 02 dated 06.07.2010 concerns design, control and monitoring of pit and dump slopes in opencast mines.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a diesel generator set, the governor controls:
questions.solution: Governor regulates fuel supply to maintain constant engine speed despite load changes.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The flywheel in a DG set is used to:
questions.solution: Flywheel stores rotational energy and reduces speed variation between power strokes.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A rescue-trained person shall practise with breathing apparatus at least:
options: 8 times a year, of which 4 in mines
4 times a year, of which 2 in mines
questions.solution: MRR 1985: rescue-trained persons practise with breathing apparatus at least 8 times a year, including 4 practices in the mine.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A rescue room is required at a mine where the number of persons employed belowground exceeds 100 and:
options: The mine produces less than 100 tonnes a day
There is no rescue station within 35 km
questions.solution: MRR 1985: a rescue room is required when more than 100 persons work belowground and no rescue station is within 35 km.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The no-load voltage of an alternator is always higher than the rated voltage due to:
questions.solution: At no load, there is no armature reaction or impedance drop, so E_f > V.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Open Circuit Characteristic (OCC) of an alternator gives the relationship between:
options: Generated EMF and field current at no load
questions.solution: OCC is plotted at no load and rated speed, showing E_f vs I_f. Saturation is visible on this curve.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: As per the Mines Rescue Rules 1985, a rescue station shall be under the charge of a Superintendent assisted by at least:
options: 2 instructors and a rescue brigade of at least 18 rescue-trained persons
questions.solution: MRR 1985: a rescue station has a Superintendent, at least 2 instructors and a rescue brigade of at least 18 rescue-trained persons.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Synchronous impedance Z_s of an alternator is calculated as:
options: OCC voltage at rated I_f / SCC current at same I_f
questions.solution: Z_s = E_f (from OCC at rated I_f) / I_sc (from SCC at same I_f). This is the EMF method.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Which method of voltage regulation uses both OCC and SCC?
questions.solution: The EMF method uses OCC and SCC and gives conservative (higher) regulation values.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The MMF method of voltage regulation is also known as:
questions.solution: MMF method uses armature MMF in place of impedance drops and gives optimistic regulation.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In the Potier triangle method, the Potier reactance is approximately equal to:
questions.solution: Potier reactance X_p ≈ X_l (leakage reactance). It separates leakage from armature reaction.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Which type of cooling is used in large turbo-alternators for highest efficiency?
questions.solution: Hydrogen has ~7× better heat transfer than air and low windage losses.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Hydrogen cooling in alternators requires hydrogen to be maintained at:
questions.solution: Hydrogen is maintained at 2–3 bar gauge to prevent air ingress.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a boiler in a thermal power plant is to:
options: Generate steam at high pressure and temperature
questions.solution: Boiler converts water to superheated steam using heat from fuel combustion.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A deaerator in a thermal power plant is used to:
questions.solution: Deaerator removes dissolved gases (especially oxygen) from feedwater to prevent corrosion.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The economizer in a boiler is used to:
questions.solution: Economizer recovers heat from exhaust flue gases to preheat feedwater, improving boiler efficiency.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An air preheater in a thermal power plant:
options: Preheats combustion air using flue gases
questions.solution: Air preheater recovers waste heat from flue gases to warm incoming combustion air.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a cooling tower in a thermal power plant is to:
options: Cool warm water from the condenser
questions.solution: Cooling tower rejects waste heat to atmosphere by evaporative cooling.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a natural draft cooling tower, the draft is created by:
options: Difference in air density due to temperature difference
questions.solution: Warm moist air inside is lighter than cool dry air outside, creating natural updraft.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The main components of a gas turbine power plant are:
questions.solution: Gas turbine: compressor → combustion chamber → turbine. Brayton cycle governs operation.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The efficiency of a combined cycle power plant can reach approximately:
questions.solution: Combined cycle plants achieve 55–62% efficiency by using waste heat from the gas turbine.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a hydro power plant, the penstock is a:
options: Large pipe carrying water from reservoir to turbine
questions.solution: Penstock is a high-pressure conduit connecting the dam/reservoir to the turbine.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A surge tank in a hydro power plant is provided to:
options: Absorb pressure variations due to sudden load changes
questions.solution: Surge tank absorbs water hammer pressure when turbine load changes suddenly.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a draft tube in a reaction turbine is to:
options: Convert kinetic energy to pressure energy
questions.solution: Draft tube converts exit KE to pressure head and conducts water to tailrace.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Specific speed of a turbine indicates:
options: Speed for a unit head and unit power
questions.solution: Specific speed N_s = N√P / H^(5/4) characterizes turbine type: low for Pelton, high for Kaplan.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A Pelton wheel is fitted with:
questions.solution: Pelton wheel has spoon-shaped buckets and a spear valve to control jet size.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a nuclear power plant, control rods are made of:
questions.solution: Control rods absorb neutrons. Boron, cadmium, and hafnium are common neutron-absorber materials.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The breeding reactor produces:
options: More fissile material than it consumes
questions.solution: A breeder reactor converts U-238 to Pu-239, producing more fuel than consumed.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Which gas is primarily released by burning fossil fuels contributing to greenhouse effect?
questions.solution: CO₂ is the primary greenhouse gas released by combustion of coal, oil, and natural gas.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The efficiency of a solar PV panel typically ranges between:
questions.solution: Commercial monocrystalline panels achieve 18–22%, polycrystalline 15–18%.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A charge controller in a solar PV system prevents:
questions.solution: Charge controller regulates voltage/current from panels to prevent battery overcharging.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: MPPT in a solar PV system stands for:
questions.solution: MPPT continuously adjusts load to operate the PV array at its maximum power point.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Wind turbine blades are typically made of:
questions.solution: FRP offer high strength-to-weight ratio and fatigue resistance.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The gearbox in a wind turbine is used to:
options: Increase speed from low-speed rotor to generator
questions.solution: Blade rotor spins at 10–20 rpm; gearbox steps this up to 1000–1500 rpm for the generator.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Rescue Rules 1985, the breathing apparatus kept at a rescue station or rescue room shall:
options: Be of the same type and make
Be of different types for flexibility
questions.solution: MRR 1985, Rule 11(4): breathing apparatus at a rescue station/room must be of the same type and make for interchangeability.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The tip-speed ratio (TSR) of a wind turbine is the ratio of:
options: Blade tip speed to wind speed
Wind speed to blade tip speed
questions.solution: TSR = ωR/V_wind. Optimal TSR is typically 6–8 for modern three-bladed turbines.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a DG set, the alternator is typically of:
questions.solution: DG alternators use cylindrical rotors for smooth operation at 1500/1800 rpm.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A brushless excitation system in an alternator eliminates the need for:
questions.solution: A rotating diode assembly on the shaft rectifies AC from a pilot exciter, eliminating slip rings.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The voltage regulation of an alternator with resistive load is:
options: Positive and less than with inductive load
questions.solution: At resistive load, armature reaction is partly demagnetizing, giving smaller positive regulation.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Leading power factor load on an alternator causes:
questions.solution: Leading PF causes magnetizing armature reaction, raising terminal voltage.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A zero power factor (ZPF) test on an alternator is performed to determine:
options: Potier reactance and armature reaction MMF
questions.solution: ZPF saturation curve helps separate leakage reactance from armature reaction MMF.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The power developed in an alternator is proportional to:
questions.solution: Electrical power P = VI cosφ = (E_f V / X_s) sinδ, the latter being the power-angle equation.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The maximum power an alternator can deliver occurs at a load angle δ of:
questions.solution: P_max = E_f V / X_s occurs at δ = 90°.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Stability limit of an alternator is usually operated at δ of approximately:
questions.solution: Practical operating limit is around 30°–45° for adequate stability margin.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The inverted V-curves of a synchronous motor show relationship between:
questions.solution: Inverted V-curves plot PF vs I_f. Maximum PF occurs near rated field current.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A synchronous condenser is essentially a:
options: Synchronous motor running at no load and over-excited
questions.solution: Synchronous condenser provides controllable reactive power compensation.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Every mechanised outlet (shaft or incline) is examined at least once in every 7 days by:
options: An engineer, electrical supervisor or foreman, or a competent person authorised by the engineer
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 75(2): mechanised outlets are examined at least once in 7 days by an engineer, electrical supervisor or foreman (or authorised competent person), recorded in a bound paged book.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A flywheel is used on a synchronous motor to:
questions.solution: Flywheel's large moment of inertia resists speed variations, damping oscillations.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In gassy mines, electric lighting from a source external to the lighting unit may be used on any roadway or place:
options: Ventilated by intake air or not within 270 m of the nearest face
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 176(1): external-source electric lighting is permitted on intake-air roadways or places not within 270 m of the nearest face.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A pony motor is sometimes used to start a synchronous motor by:
options: Cranking the rotor to near synchronous speed
questions.solution: Pony motor brings rotor close to synchronous speed, then field is energized for pull-in.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The pull-out torque of a synchronous motor is approximately:
questions.solution: Pull-out torque is typically 1.5–2.5× rated torque.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Every engine, motor, transformer and battery-charging room on the surface of a mine shall be provided with at least:
options: Two exits, properly maintained and kept free from obstruction
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 212: such rooms are kept clean and provided with at least two exits, properly maintained and free from obstruction.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a thermal power plant, the function of an economizer is to:
options: Preheat feedwater from flue gas heat
questions.solution: Economizer uses waste heat in flue gases to raise feedwater temperature.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: For electrical machinery and plant, the competent person for inspection under CMR 2017 shall be an engineer or electrician holding qualifications specified in:
options: CEA (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations, 2010
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(6): the competent person for electrical machinery holds qualifications as specified in the CEA Safety & Electric Supply Regulations, 2010.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Which component removes dissolved oxygen from boiler feedwater?
questions.solution: Deaerator heats feedwater to remove dissolved O₂ and CO₂, preventing corrosion.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The standard LT voltage level in India is:
questions.solution: LT distribution: 415 V three-phase, 230 V single-phase.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: HT distribution in India primarily operates at:
questions.solution: 11 kV is the standard HT distribution voltage.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A distribution transformer of 100 kVA, 11/0.433 kV steps down voltage from:
questions.solution: 11 kV primary → 433 V secondary.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a thorough inspection of all machinery and plant in use is required at least once in every:
options: 7 days, recorded in a bound paged book
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(5): a competent person thoroughly inspects all machinery and plant at least once in 7 days, recording results in a bound paged book.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: ACSR conductor 'Dog' has a current carrying capacity of approximately:
questions.solution: Dog conductor (7/3.66 mm) has approximate current capacity of 335 A.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: ACSR conductor 'Panther' is used for:
questions.solution: Panther (30/3.05 mm) is suitable for 11 kV HT distribution lines.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: ACSR 'Drake' conductor is commonly used for:
questions.solution: Drake is a large conductor for 33/66 kV sub-transmission lines.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: ACSR 'Rabbit' conductor is used for:
questions.solution: Rabbit (6/3.40 mm) is a small conductor for LT distribution.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Maximum operating temperature of XLPE insulated cable is:
questions.solution: XLPE cables rated for continuous 90°C and 250°C short-circuit temperature.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: PVC insulated cables have a maximum conductor operating temperature of:
questions.solution: PVC cables rated for 70°C continuous and 160°C short-circuit.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Direct laying method of cable installation is suitable for:
questions.solution: Direct burial is cheapest but only suitable without vehicular traffic.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable laying in concrete trenches is preferred in:
questions.solution: Concrete trench with cover provides mechanical protection in areas with traffic.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Sag in an overhead line is the:
options: Difference in height of two supports
Maximum dip of conductor from the line joining supports
questions.solution: Sag is the maximum vertical deflection of the conductor.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Sag in an overhead line increases with:
questions.solution: Sag = wl²/(8T). Increases with span, weight, and temperature.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Tension in an overhead conductor is:
questions.solution: For given span and load, increased tension reduces sag.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The safe span length for an 11 kV OH line with ACSR Panther conductor is typically:
questions.solution: Typical span for 11 kV HT distribution is 80–120 m.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Pin insulators are generally used up to:
questions.solution: Pin insulators are economical up to 11 kV.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: An article is sold for ₹600 at a 20% loss. What was the cost price?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: If 3A = 4B = 5C, what is A:B:C?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: If the selling price is ₹900 and the profit is 50%, what is the cost price?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: A man walks at 5 km/h for 6 hours and then at 4 km/h for 4 hours. What is his average speed?
questions.solution: Total distance = 30 + 16 = 46 km. Total time = 10 hours. Average = 4.6 km/h

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Synonym of EMPIRICAL:
questions.solution: Empirical: based on experiment

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Antonym of EXPLICIT:
questions.solution: Explicit: clear; antonym: implicit

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Fill in: He insisted ___ going alone.
questions.solution: Insist on

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Synonym of COURAGEOUS:
questions.solution: Courageous: brave

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Antonym of DILIGENT:
questions.solution: Diligent: hardworking; antonym: lazy

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Fill in: This is the place ___ I was born.
questions.solution: Where (relative adverb)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Identify error: Each of the boys have completed.
questions.solution: Each...has (singular verb)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Synonym of TRANSPARENT:
questions.solution: Transparent: clear

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Antonym of PERSEVERE:
questions.solution: Persevere: persist; antonym: quit

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India's national anthem was written by:
questions.solution: Jana Gana Mana by Tagore

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Indian national song was written by:
questions.solution: Vande Mataram by Bankim Chandra

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Who was the first President of India?
questions.solution: Dr. Rajendra Prasad: first President (1950-1962)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Who was the first Prime Minister of India?
questions.solution: Nehru: first PM (1947-1964)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India's independence was signed on:
questions.solution: Independence: 15 August 1947

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Who is known as Iron Man of India?
questions.solution: Sardar Patel: Iron Man

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Quit India Movement was launched in:
questions.solution: Quit India: August 1942
